newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn no longer interested buying French missile.
newsitem.headline: Bonn no longer interested buying French missile.

text.p: Germany, squeezed by cuts in defence spending, confirmed on Tuesday it had broken off talks over buying the French-made Apache air-launched cruise missile for its Tornado combat jets.
A government source who requested anonymity said that Bonn had informed its French partners it would no longer pursue its interest in the Apache missile. He declined to elaborate.
French newspaper Les Echos reported earlier that Germany's BWB arms procurement office had written to its French counterpart to say it would not buy an anti-runway version of the Apache missile.
Groupe Lagardere's Matra Defense Espace subsidiary is prime contractor on the Apache missile, with state-owned SNI Aerospatiale as a subcontractor.
Negotiations over the Apache date back to the early 1990s, but no firm order was ever placed after its development programme ran into delays, the German source said.
Germany remains in talks with France over another missile system, the source added, again declining to elaborate.
